title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident young woman with dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose, holding a massive purple warhammer. She wears an orange cropped top with tribal patterns, dark purple pants, and matching armored boots and wristbands, with a cheeky smile and one fist raised near her face.
